summary: Finished it, such a nice game, easily one of my fav this year. If Forbidden Solitaire gets extra content/DLC I'll be there day one. Fun fact I played this almost entirely on a Steam Machine, which might sound weird but it was very comfortable to casually play with the trackpad/right stick.
